data.gender_notes: Baneera is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Baneera is derived from the Arabic word 'Banat Al Nar', meaning 'daughters of the light'. In Islamic culture, this name signifies radiance, enlightenment, and illumination. It is a name of great spiritual significance, reminding us of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in our lives. The name Baneera carries the meaning “Bright, shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baneera usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Baneera belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baneera total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
